component.name: TVGuideScene

Label.text: What's on right now across every channel

component.script:
sub init() m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.status = m.top.findNode("status") m.rows.observeField("itemSelected", "onRowSelected") fetchSchedule() end sub
sub fetchSchedule() m.status.text = "Loading guide…" m.fetcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ScheduleFetcher") m.fetcher.apiBase = m.top.apiBase m.fetcher.observeField("result", "onScheduleLoaded") m.fetcher.observeField("error", "onScheduleError") m.fetcher.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onScheduleLoaded() data = m.fetcher.result if data = invalid or data.schedules = invalid m.status.text = "No guide data" return end if nowSecs = secondsSinceMidnightET() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.rowChannels = [] for each s in data.schedules cname = s.channel_name if cname = invalid then cname = "Unknown" cid = s.channel_id if cid = invalid then cid = "" nowTitle = "-- off air --" nowStart = "" if s.videos <> invalid for each v in s.videos startS = hhmmssToSec(v.start_time) endS = hhmmssToSec(v.end_time) if nowSecs >= startS and nowSecs < endS nowTitle = v.title nowStart = v.start_time exit for end if end for end if pad = padRight(cname, 26) startPad = padRight(nowStart, 10) line = pad + " " + startPad + " " + nowTitle if Len(line) > 140 then line = Left(line, 137) + "…" it = content.createChild("ContentNode") it.title = line m.rowChannels.Push({ id: cid, name: cname }) end for m.rows.content = content m.status.text = "OK to tune in · Back to return" m.rows.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onScheduleError() m.status.text = "Guide error: " + m.fetcher.error end sub
function hhmmssToSec(s as dynamic) as Integer if s = invalid then return 0 t = s.Split(":") if t.Count() >= 3 then return Val(t[0])*3600 + Val(t[1])*60 + Val(t[2]) if t.Count() = 2 then return Val(t[0])*60 + Val(t[1]) return Val(t[0]) end function
function secondsSinceMidnightET() as Integer ' Roku doesn't have zoneinfo; use system time (typically local), ' but we render start_time strings straight from the server, so ' "now" comparison uses local device seconds. Good enough for a ' current-slot highlight; slots come from the server pre-rendered. dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() return dt.GetHours()*3600 + dt.GetMinutes()*60 + dt.GetSeconds() end function
function padRight(s as string, n as integer) as string out = s while Len(out) < n out = out + " " end while if Len(out) > n then out = Left(out, n) return out end function
sub onRowSelected() idx = m.rows.itemSelected if m.rowChannels = invalid or idx < 0 or idx >= m.rowChannels.Count() then return m.top.selectedChannelId = m.rowChannels[idx].id end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" m.top.closed = true return true end if return false end function
